item.title: Fatal Crash, Capital Shooting, Immigration Crackdown
item.ns0:title: Fatal Crash, Capital Shooting, Immigration Crackdown
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, a tragic late-night collision on Fox Hill Road leaves one man dead and another driver hospitalized as police investigate the cause of the fatal crash. We bring you the latest on a weekend shooting in the capital and the mass conviction of dozens of foreign nationals facing deportation for immigration offenses. Foreign Affairs Minister Fred Mitchell weighs in on the aspirational timeline for elections in Haiti, while Fox Hill residents receive exciting news about a major expansion in affordable housing. Plus, we highlight the dominance of Team Bahamas in the pool and go behind the scenes of a star-studded music festival at Atlantis.
